				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_economy_research_speed_factor > 0 } }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { var = TFR_SPA_credit_economy_research_speed_factor value = 0.025 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
						subtract_from_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_economy_research_speed_factor = 0.025 }
						set_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_grant = 0 }
					}
					else = {
						subtract_from_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_grant = TFR_SPA_credit_economy_research_speed_factor }
						set_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_economy_research_speed_factor = 0 }
					}
				}
				add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_base_economy_research_speed_factor = TFR_SPA_grant }

				TFR_SPA_refresh_modifiers = yes

	available_if_capitulated = no
	cancel_if_invalid = yes
	allow_branch = { always = yes }
	prerequisite = { focus = TFR_SPA_national_research_council }
	ai_will_do = { factor = 1 }
	completion_reward = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = TFR_SPA_reward_P12 } }
			hidden_effect = { TFR_SPA_apply_balance_revision = yes }
			set_country_flag = TFR_SPA_reward_P12
			custom_effect_tooltip = TFR_SPA_economy_modifier_tt
			add_to_variable = {
				TFR_SPA_base_economy_consumer_goods_factor = -0.05
				tooltip = consumer_goods_factor_tt
			}

			add_to_variable = {
				TFR_SPA_base_economy_production_factory_efficiency_gain_factor = 0.05
				tooltip = production_factory_efficiency_gain_factor_tt
			}

			custom_effect_tooltip = generic_skip_one_line_tt
			add_stability = 0.05
			add_political_power = 50
			if = { limit = { has_country_leader = { character = SPA_francisco_franco ruling_only = yes } } swap_ruler_traits = { remove = caudillo_1 add = caudillo_2 } }
			hidden_effect = {
				subtract_from_variable = { TFR_SPA_base_economy_consumer_goods_factor = -0.05 }
				set_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_grant = -0.05 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_economy_consumer_goods_factor < 0 } }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { var = TFR_SPA_credit_economy_consumer_goods_factor value = -0.05 compare = less_than_or_equals } }
						subtract_from_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_economy_consumer_goods_factor = -0.05 }
						set_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_grant = 0 }
					}
					else = {
						subtract_from_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_grant = TFR_SPA_credit_economy_consumer_goods_factor }
						set_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_economy_consumer_goods_factor = 0 }
					}
				}
				add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_base_economy_consumer_goods_factor = TFR_SPA_grant }

				subtract_from_variable = { TFR_SPA_base_economy_production_factory_efficiency_gain_factor = 0.05 }
				set_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_grant = 0.05 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_economy_production_factory_efficiency_gain_factor > 0 } }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { var = TFR_SPA_credit_economy_production_factory_efficiency_gain_factor value = 0.05 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
						subtract_from_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_economy_production_factory_efficiency_gain_factor = 0.05 }
						set_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_grant = 0 }
					}
					else = {
						subtract_from_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_grant = TFR_SPA_credit_economy_production_factory_efficiency_gain_factor }
						set_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_economy_production_factory_efficiency_gain_factor = 0 }
					}
				}
				add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_base_economy_production_factory_efficiency_gain_factor = TFR_SPA_grant }

				TFR_SPA_flush_building_rewards = yes
				TFR_SPA_refresh_modifiers = yes
			}
		}
	}

						subtract_from_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_economy_industrial_capacity_factory = 0.05 }

					limit = { check_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_building_civ > 0 } }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { var = TFR_SPA_credit_building_civ value = 2 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
						subtract_from_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_building_civ = 2 }
						set_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_grant = 0 }
					}
					else = {
						subtract_from_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_grant = TFR_SPA_credit_building_civ }
						set_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_building_civ = 0 }
					}
				}
				add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_pending_167_civ = TFR_SPA_grant }

				TFR_SPA_flush_building_rewards = yes
				TFR_SPA_refresh_modifiers = yes
			}

	completion_reward = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = TFR_SPA_reward_M10 } }
			hidden_effect = { TFR_SPA_apply_balance_revision = yes }
			set_country_flag = TFR_SPA_reward_M10
			custom_effect_tooltip = TFR_SPA_army_modifier_tt
			add_to_variable = {
				TFR_SPA_base_army_special_forces_attack_factor = 0.025
				tooltip = special_forces_attack_factor_tt
			}

			custom_effect_tooltip = generic_skip_one_line_tt
			add_tech_bonus = { name = TFR_SPA_amphibious_warfare_school bonus = 0.5 uses = 1 category = marine_tech }

			hidden_effect = {
				subtract_from_variable = { TFR_SPA_base_army_special_forces_attack_factor = 0.025 }
				set_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_grant = 0.025 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_army_special_forces_attack_factor > 0 } }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { var = TFR_SPA_credit_army_special_forces_attack_factor value = 0.025 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
						subtract_from_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_army_special_forces_attack_factor = 0.025 }
						set_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_grant = 0 }
					}
					else = {
						subtract_from_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_grant = TFR_SPA_credit_army_special_forces_attack_factor }
						set_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_army_special_forces_attack_factor = 0 }
					}
				}
				add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_base_army_special_forces_attack_factor = TFR_SPA_grant }

				TFR_SPA_flush_building_rewards = yes
				TFR_SPA_refresh_modifiers = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { var = TFR_SPA_credit_army_army_fuel_consumption_factor value = -0.05 compare = less_than_or_equals } }
						subtract_from_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_army_army_fuel_consumption_factor = -0.05 }
						set_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_grant = 0 }
					}
					else = {
						subtract_from_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_grant = TFR_SPA_credit_army_army_fuel_consumption_factor }
						set_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_army_army_fuel_consumption_factor = 0 }
					}
				}
				add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_base_army_army_fuel_consumption_factor = TFR_SPA_grant }

				subtract_from_variable = { TFR_SPA_base_army_army_armor_speed_factor = 0.05 }
				set_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_grant = 0.05 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_army_army_armor_speed_factor > 0 } }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { var = TFR_SPA_credit_army_army_armor_speed_factor value = 0.05 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
						subtract_from_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_army_army_armor_speed_factor = 0.05 }
						set_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_grant = 0 }
					}
					else = {
						subtract_from_temp_variable = { TFR_SPA_grant = TFR_SPA_credit_army_army_armor_speed_factor }
						set_variable = { TFR_SPA_credit_army_army_armor_speed_factor = 0 }
					}
				}
				add_to_variable = { TFR_SPA_base_army_army_armor_speed_factor = TFR_SPA_grant }
